summary: Make ekodi.kr the canonical human, user, administrator, authentication and system path surface while preserving existing subdomain runtimes only as justified internal, emergency or compatibility execution boundaries.
approvalBasis: The platform owner explicitly approved the one-domain model and instructed end-to-end implementation, verification, deployment and operation.
migrationPlan: Introduce apex path routing first, keep legacy runtimes reachable behind service bindings, migrate first-party links and admin navigation, then redirect or retain legacy hosts according to compatibility evidence.
securityModel: One domain, multiple security realms. /admin, /auth, /api, /mcp and /webhooks retain distinct authorization, CSP, token, audit, rate-limit and protocol controls despite sharing the canonical host.
rollback: Disable canonical surface routing in the apex entry worker and restore legacy subdomain entrypoints. Existing service workers and emergency entries remain available during rollout.
verificationPolicy: Constitution, route contract, auth/admin/my/API/MCP tests, build, staging, conflict guard, guarded main promotion and production real-host probes must pass.
